name: Aligned Spell (Metamagic)
body:
Those whom your deity favors have nothing to fear from you.

Prerequisite(s): chaotic, evil, good, or lawful alignment; Spellcraft 10 ranks.

Benefit(s): This feat works as Selective Spell, except rather than choosing the targets that are excluded from the spell’s effect, you select an alignment you have when casting an aligned spell. All targets who share this alignment with you are automatically excluded from the spell’s effect, regardless of their number. You may decide whether to inflict no damage or half damage to creatures who are neutral with respect to the chosen alignment axis (if the aligned spell doesn’t inflict damage, a neutral creature would get a +4 bonus on its saving throw instead of half damage). An aligned spell uses up a spell slot 2 levels higher than the spell’s actual level.

An aligned spell must have a duration of instantaneous but has not to be a spell with an area of effect.
